column3: when an architect is next commissioned in this record (the conformance pass of the next plan, or the owner's word), and before any brief cites system-architecture.md § Roadmap Readiness for the state of plans 012-014

>- Re-read this if a DB-backed integration harness is proposed for any reason, if `backfillValid.ts` is modified, if a second backfill-style mass-mutation script is written for any table, or if anyone proposes running such a script against a host reached through a unix socket.

when the next website or preview-image-generator effort is scoped, or when a user report names one of the surfaces below (getFromUrl, the /generate endpoint, a stored message's preview image, the Upload Message / sign-out paths)

when a researcher is next commissioned in this record, and before research/codebase-bug-evaluation-2026-11-08.md is closed or its Recommendation 3 or gap G-4 is cited as an instruction for a host read

>- Re-read this if a user reports a V2 message failing to send with no explanation from the UI, if work is proposed on the composer's send gate or on `validateContentRequirements`, if the set of supported V2 component types changes, or if anyone proposes determining Discord's acceptance rules by sending live messages.

>- Re-read this if anyone proposes work on the message-mode toggles, the JSON import or reconcile paths, the persist/seed/hash serialisers, or any change keyed on the Components V2 flag - and before any future plan cites system-architecture.md for what determines a message's mode, since the record is currently wrong on exactly that point.
>- Re-read this if a user reports cached local message edits disappearing after a refresh at `/message/m/0`, or if anyone proposes writing a new test for MessageProvider's route-0 initialization.

>- Re-read this if BC-17 (`agent-output/qa/closed/013-components-v2-editing-surfaces-qa.md`, "discord-returns-row-e") is ever discharged — i.e. if a real Discord message carrying both V2 components and classic content is observed coming back through the import path — since that is exactly the shape this finding says the user cannot currently save through `NewMessageModal`. Also re-read if anyone proposes adding coverage for `NewMessageModal.onSubmit`'s `pendingChoice` branch.
when a Hooks user holding more than one Discord Accounts row is found (a database read) or reported

>- Re-read this if anyone reports missing or broken preview images, if the generator service is restarted, redeployed or has its credentials rotated (each is a window in which every save during the outage rotates a nonce with nothing behind it), if anyone proposes changing the nonce or retention behaviour, or before anyone proposes replacing the generator service — the failure path is part of what a replacement has to reproduce.
When either preview-image-generator workflow file is next edited, when the generator's API key is rotated, or when the repository's visibility is changed or reviewed — whichever comes first.
the next production stop of hooks-image-preview-generator-prod whose process has served requests (any later prod.yml deploy or restart); and before any PM2 upgrade on the generator host past 5.x

when a preview-image-generator commit changes the generic-pool version its package-lock.json resolves (3.9.0 at 8de2b53); the same event triggers handoff/preview-image-generator-host-security-posture-2026-11-08.md

When puppeteer or generic-pool is next bumped in preview-image-generator; when the generator host is next rebuilt, re-provisioned or its Node interpreter changed; when `.github/deploy.sh` or either generator workflow file is next edited; when a vulnerability in Chrome 116.0.5845.96 or Node 18.17.1 is reported as exploited against the product; or when the premise of the acceptance moves — the audience or data Hooks handles changes (architecture `preview-image-generator.md` P-4's scope clause) — whichever comes first
when src/app/_components/Providers.tsx getMessage or src/middleware.ts is next edited, or when the next website hardening effort is scoped
when QA next runs in this record, or when the next website test effort is scoped

>- Re-read this before any work on the save path, the message-update / concurrent-edit detection, or the multi-tab reconcile - and before anyone cites BC-14 as evidence that the original user-reported defect is fully fixed in production, because BC-14 returned a finding on one limb and its two count-based limbs were never numerically observed.

>- Re-read this before anyone changes `hasChanged` in `MessageProvider`, changes what `enabled: false` means in `ConfirmationProvider`, adds a new consumer of `hasChanged`, or changes who may edit a message without signing in — that last one converts this from a latent gap into an active one.
when src/components/AnchoredPopover/Child.tsx or NewMessageModal is next edited, or when the next website effort is scoped
